verdict.rationale: Plausible offers explicit CSV export/import features and a Stats API for querying data, plus fully open-source self-hosted Community Edition ensuring no lock-in, supporting data portability and 'leave anytime' freedom. However, there's no evidence of comprehensive full-data export (e.g., raw events) beyond aggregate stats/CSV, and no machine-readable llms.txt/OpenAPI spec was found (probes returned 404s), limiting AI-native automated export/consumption.
